Unbounded endpoints give infinitely distinct n. The finite verifier independently confirms congruence programming and local arithmetic identities; it is not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The original discrepancy problem concerns the maximal prime-partition cardinality versus maximum-product cardinality. The every-progression theorem rules out all modular obstructions simultaneously, including nonunit residue classes; this is a natural structural strengthening of the original existential theorem. The residue-programmable product-minimal construction is the substantive new mechanism, not a choice of a numerical special case.
